direct_answer: The immutable Paper source and authored denominators are proven, but the API hard-cell union does not pass. Discovery, schema retrieval, document/query reads, conditional requests, 401, 404, and request-ID correlation work. Unsupported methods return 404 instead of 405; source negotiation returns 406 with internal_error; invalid authenticated perspectives silently become published; source and public Paper responses expose no ETag; history --limit is omitted by bp; 422 and a server timeout were not safely reproduced; and production availability was intermittently 500 despite successful replays.

observations.source_identity: paper view, doc get, source blocks, filtered query, and newest history detail share the exact ordered-block hash

required_cells.discovery_schema: partial: mounted /v1/openapi.json works and conditionals pass, while docs also name unmounted /openapi.json
required_cells.typed_405: fail: unsupported POST returns 404 with no Allow header
required_cells.typed_500: partial: intermittent public Paper and capabilities 500s later succeeded
required_cells.typed_timeout: not found as server envelope; only client-side timeout evidence
required_cells.request_ids: pass: header and body IDs matched on five structured negative responses
required_cells.identity_domains: partial: document, source, history, query, and Cycle identities are distinct; public page revision is absent
required_cells.conditionals: partial: OpenAPI, capabilities, document, and query return 304; source and public Paper lack ETag
required_cells.pagination_perspective: fail: history limit omitted and invalid authenticated perspective silently becomes published

availability.successful_replay: 30/30 across OpenAPI, capabilities, source, public Paper, document API, and filtered query

inferences: Source identity is strong enough for revision-fenced repair because document, source, query, and latest history content join exactly.
The main contract seam is boundary normalization across routing, content negotiation, perspective parsing, and CLI flag serialization.
The limit=1001 latency needs profiling before assigning a root cause.
Successful retries do not erase the observed intermittent failures.
recommended_repair_seams: Align discovery documentation with /v1/openapi.json and add route/documentation parity proof.
Return 405 plus Allow for unsupported methods on known resources.
Replace 406 internal_error with a typed negotiation error while preserving request IDs.
Validate authenticated perspective values as an enum.
Add source and public-page ETags plus an immutable Paper revision carrier.
Serialize doc history --limit into the URL and add pagination receipts.
Create isolated fixtures for 422, 500, and server-timeout envelopes.
Profile and bound the limit=1001 Paper query.
Investigate intermittent capabilities and Paper 500s before Experiment assumes reproducibility.
risks: The API vocabulary and live boundary behavior disagree in several typed-error cells.
Public and source readers cannot prove an immutable revision from response headers.
History limits appear accepted but are not transmitted.
Intermittent 500s and a large-query timeout undermine reproducibility.
unvisited_scope: safe live 422 reproduction and controlled deterministic 500 fixture
rate limits, Retry-After, CORS, protocol parity, and load profiling
